faqs.question: How are merchant milestone payouts calculated and released?
faqs.answer: Merchant disbursements are triggered upon verified completion of key installation milestones (30% mobilization, 50% mounting & delivery, and final 20% net-metering commissioning). Once the assigned supervisor uploads photo proof and signed CFEI/delivery notes, funds are queued for bi-monthly release on the 1st or 15th via PESONet bank transfer.

faqs.question: Why is 2% Creditable Withholding Tax (CWT) deducted from gross commission?
faqs.answer: Under Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Revenue Regulations No. 2-98 as amended, income payments to merchants, contractors, and sales partners are subject to a statutory 2% creditable withholding tax. Hello Solar issues BIR Form 2307 (Certificate of Creditable Tax Withheld at Source) quarterly so you can claim tax credits against your quarterly corporate income tax filings.

faqs.question: What should I do if a payout status is marked 'On Hold'?
faqs.answer: An 'On Hold' status indicates that supporting documentation is pending verification—commonly missing equipment serial waybills, incomplete signed delivery receipts, or pending municipal building permit stamps. Open the payout details modal to read the specific audit note, then submit the missing file through the Support tab citing your payout reference.

faqs.question: What Single-Line Diagram (SLD) requirements are needed for Meralco net-metering?
faqs.answer: Every grid-tied or hybrid solar installation must have an electrical single-line diagram (SLD) stamped by a Philippine Registered Professional Electrical Engineer (PEE). The diagram must detail PV array capacity, DC isolators, lightning surge protection devices (SPDs), inverter AC disconnect switch, and the bi-directional utility revenue meter connection point.

faqs.question: Who files the Certificate of Final Electrical Inspection (CFEI)?
faqs.answer: Our assigned field installation crew coordinates the CFEI filing with the local government unit (LGU) Office of the Building Official (OBO). Once electrical roughing-in and inverter mounting are complete, the municipal inspector conducts an on-site audit. The merchant can track CFEI permit status in real time under the Project Details modal.

faqs.question: How long does the Meralco bi-directional meter activation take?
faqs.answer: Following CFEI issuance and submission of the Certificate of Commercial Operation (CCO), Meralco typically schedules the bi-directional meter replacement within 10 to 15 business days. Once the bi-directional meter is energized, exported solar electricity is credited to the customer's monthly power bill.

faqs.question: What is the warranty coverage on solar modules and inverters?
faqs.answer: Tier-1 solar modules (Trina Solar, Longi, Canadian Solar) carry a 12-year manufacturer product warranty and a 25-to-30 year 80% linear performance guarantee. String and hybrid inverters (Huawei, Deye, GoodWe, SMA) carry a standard 5-to-10 year replacement warranty. In the event of hardware fault, Hello Solar handles RMA logistics directly with local distributor service centers.

faqs.question: How are field installer teams allocated to solar projects?
faqs.answer: Installer crews are assigned based on geographical proximity, roof structural specialization (e.g. tile vs metal deck), and high-voltage battery certifications. Team leads are licensed REE or PEE engineers who supervise mounting safety, cable conduits, and zero-export smart meter CT calibration.

faqs.question: When can a merchant request an upgrade in partner tier and commission rate?
faqs.answer: Partners achieving over 50 kW installed capacity within a rolling 6-month period are eligible for upgrade to Platinum Partner status (5.8% commission tier with dedicated EPC priority dispatch). Contact your Hello Solar Account Manager (David Ramos) or submit an account review request via Support.

faqs.question: Are support requests submitted directly through this web interface?
faqs.answer: Support drafts created in this portal are safely preserved in your browser and can be exported as official text request files. To ensure enterprise audit compliance and swift resolution, share your downloaded request file directly with your designated Hello Solar account manager via email or Viber dispatch.
